analysis:
Reviewed all supplied units, including metadata and documentation surroundings. page.tsx head:8,33 selects provider versus desktop_account approval from a query parameter. DeviceLinkForm.tsx head:39-45 submits the code and purpose to a same-origin endpoint with the user's Privy Bearer; head:62-65 requires a desktop_account response before displaying success. Head:217 promises 30-day read-only access with no provider-start, key-management or withdrawal authority. The response check occurs after approval and cannot itself constrain a credential already issued. Documentation patch at console-ui.md head:28 asserts coordinator code-purpose matching; head:99 describes unchanged body forwarding. Neither approval handler nor coordinator issuance/polling/scope enforcement is supplied, so there is no independently supported bypass finding here.
Integration must inspect code creation, approval purpose binding before mutation, polling/issued-token scope and expiry, desktop credential storage/revocation, and rejection on provider WebSocket, API-key management and payout routes. Relevant existing contracts: A-008, TB-002, TB-011, T-052/T-053; new desktop-account credential custody/read authority may need additional threat-model coverage. Validate older-coordinator compatibility: an ignored purpose must not approve provider authority beneath read-only consent. No visible changes to inference encryption, attestation, cache isolation, billing calculations or privileged fan controls; this is a local source review, not clearance of their unchanged implementations. DeviceLinkForm base/patch and unchanged callers were not supplied.
